evidence_level: E2 held-out consensus plus E1 exact-future token-route oracle
objective: Preserve the unchanged target checkpoint while projecting a 405B-class runtime onto an 8 GiB device and a 1.2x native-4B warm-decode envelope.

heldout_consensus.decision: survive the pre-registered held-out falsification set

uniform_layer_subset_oracle.decision: corrective subset exists but has insufficient implementation headroom

token_routed_layer_oracle.decision: advance token-routed precision into causal route prediction

non_negotiable_limitations: Exact-future labels selected the corrective routes; this is an existence proof, not a deployable selector.
Q4/Q6 measurements use authoritative exact prefixes and therefore do not solve causal candidate-block generation.
The 405B timing numbers are roofline projections, not measured 8 GiB GPU wall-clock results.
The 0.4 consensus rule survived 288 held-out tokens but is not a mathematical correctness certificate.

next_gate.name: causal staged residual routing
next_gate.requirement: Select and stop Q6-to-Q8 residual layer stages using only current-prefix Q4/Q6 logits, margins, and stage-to-stage stability, then pass a second held-out prompt set without unsafe accepts.
next_gate.separate_unsolved_gate: Generate a multi-token candidate block without authoritative future target tokens while avoiding a full target-weight pass per committed token.
